Media: when confronted with whataboutism re: #BLM , please ask your interviewee about the zip ties. 

The self-proclaimed revolutionaries carried zip ties to the Capitol. They were ready to take hostages.  In the US Capitol. 

Ask them about the zip ties.

A lot of the activity- including by elected officials- leading up to and during 1/6/21 can be criminally prosecuted without endangering vital, peaceful movements for racial and social justice, like #BLM. 

The analogy of Ulysses bound to the mast has never been more apt.  //
